I farm a small plot here on the slopes, just one-third of a hectare, and I plant beans together with a few maize stalks like my mother showed me. I do not have much cash this season, so I will not buy the fertilizer from the shop — beans make their own food in the soil, everyone here knows that. I keep two goats and a few chickens, so I will carry their manure to the plot before the rains, the way I always do. For seed I will use what I saved from last harvest, the small red beans that do well on this hillside, and I will weed twice with my daughter-in-law helping me.
